g.text: Circle / Sphere — the originating perfect form, infinite symmetry. Every other shape is a deviation, truncation, or approximation of it.
Curved half ◖ — continuous, spectral, generated by rotation (solids of revolution, conics, rosettes, Σ-182 bridge).
Discrete half ◗ — the Circle broken into harmony: regular polygons, polyhedra (Platonic/Archimedean), lattices, figurate numbers.
Dimensional ladder: 0D Monad (Nucleus) → 1D Dyad/Line (Atom) → 2D Surface (Algebraic) → Δ∮◯Σ (Calculi) → 3D Solid (Geometric + Quadrants).
Canonical axioms: π = 14 · b = 3 (derived from base-3 uniqueness). Forge exemplar (7,11,13) is a worked example, NOT a fixed axiom.
Trit canonical = Rep-C: zeros forbidden by default — the trit carries only ±, preserving the directional (convex/concave) nature of the Dyad. Security invariant.
repx.rs → Atom ring (canonical bijective base-b). milesian.rs → Atomic Nucleus (b³ Greek-Atomic glyph register). walk.rs → Algebraic ring (coprime walks + CRT).
8 physics modules moved from the Geometric disc into the 4 corner Physics Quadrants. All four sub-calculi (Δ Difference · ∮ Circular · ◯ Iteration · Σ Series) live in calculus.rs.
